description: This file defines structures and functions for reading Linux kernel pressure stall information (PSI) from /proc/pressure/* files, including parsing PSI data for CPU, memory, and I/O resources.

classes.name: PSILine
classes.description: Represents a single line of pressure stall information with averages over 10, 60, and 300 seconds, and a total in microseconds.

classes.name: PSIStats
classes.description: Holds pressure stall data for 'some' and 'full' resource pressure states.

methods.name: PSIStatsForResource
methods.description: Reads pressure stall information for a specified resource ('cpu', 'memory', or 'io') from /proc/pressure/<resource>.

methods.name: parsePSIStats
methods.description: Parses PSI data from an io.Reader, extracting 'some' and 'full' pressure lines.
